incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street in a town is flooded with muddy water, submerging the lower floors of multi-story buildings and street signs.

observations.description: Brown, muddy water covers the street, reaching the lower levels of buildings and partially submerging street signs and infrastructure.
Multi-story buildings with storefronts on the ground floor; some have visible signs and awnings. A 'STOP' sign and directional arrow sign are partially submerged.
No people are visible in the image.
No visible structural damage to buildings other than water submersion.

inconsistencies: Report mentions Nabeul, but the architecture and signage suggest a European town, not Nabeul (which is in Tunisia).
not_determinable: Depth of water relative to building entrances
Number of buildings or streets affected
